entries.jp:
彦根から京に
戻ってきた龍馬たちは
以前より精力的に
雷舞を繰り返した
entries.en:
After returning
to Kyoto from
Hikone, Ryoma
and the others
held live after
live, more
energetically
than ever.

entries.jp: 彦根で見た\n洗脳された民の姿が\n脳裏に焼き付いている
entries.en:
The sight of the
brainwashed
people they had
seen in Hikone
was seared into
their minds.

entries.jp:
京の民たちが
あのような姿に
ならないよう
龍馬たちは懸命に
歌い続けていた
entries.en:
So that the people
of Kyoto would
never end up like
that, Ryoma and
the others kept
singing with all
their might.

entries.jp: 今日もいい天気じゃ！\n心が晴れ晴れするな！
entries.en: Another fine day\ntoday! Clears the\nheart right up!

entries.jp: 絶好の雷舞日和と\nいうやつじゃ！
entries.en: Perfect weather\nfor a live, as\nthey say!

entries.jp: こりゃあ　おてんと様も\nわしらの雷舞を楽しみに\nしとるに違いない
entries.en:
I bet even the
sun's lookin'
forward to
our live!

entries.jp: あははは\nそうかもしれませんね\n龍馬くんは前向きだなぁ
entries.en:
Ahahaha, maybe
so. You're so
positive,
Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: ちっ　そのバカを\n図にのせるな　桂さん
entries.en:
Tch. Don't
encourage
the idiot,
Katsura-san.

entries.jp: シンディはこんな\n上天気でも不機嫌\nなのか　もったいない
entries.en:
Shindy, you're
grumpy even on
a day this sunny?
What a waste.

entries.jp: 不機嫌で悪かったな\nお前みたいなのを\n能天気と言うんだ
entries.en:
Sorry for being
grumpy. Guys like
you have nothing
but sunshine
between the ears.

entries.jp: あ　晋作にしては\nうまい切り返しですね\n上天気に能天気かぁ
entries.en:
Oh, that's a
good comeback,
for Shinsaku.
Sunshine in the
sky, sunshine
between the
ears, hm?

entries.jp: おお
entries.en: Ooh!

entries.jp: だから\n二人してそう呑気に\n構えるのはよせっ！
entries.en: Which is why you\ntwo need to quit\nbeing so carefree!

entries.jp: オレ達は幕府に真っ向から\n逆らって雷舞をやるんだぞ
entries.en:
We're defying
the shogunate
head-on to put
on our live,
you know!

entries.jp: 天気がいいなんて理由で\n連中が　オレ様達を見逃す\nとでもいうのか？
entries.en:
You think
those guys will
let us off just
because the
weather's nice?

entries.jp: 敵は鳳舞合奏ってな\n大技を用意してるんだ\n少しは気を引き締めろ
entries.en:
The enemy's got
a big move ready
called Phoenix
Rising. Tighten
up a little.

entries.jp: は？　幕府のコトなんて\n今　わしは考えちゃおらん
entries.en:
Huh? I ain't
thinkin' about
the shogunate
right now.

entries.jp: なんだと？
entries.en: What?

entries.jp: 曇りや雨だったりしたら\n歌も変えなくちゃ\nならんからな
entries.en:
If it's cloudy or
rainy, I gotta
change up the
songs, see.

entries.jp: 雨には雨の\n曇りには曇りの
entries.en: Rain's got its own,\nclouds got theirs...

entries.jp: それぞれの天気に合った\nロックが　あるぜよ
entries.en: There's a rock to\nfit every kinda\nweather, I tell ya!

entries.jp: ……ふん\nわかったようなことを\n言いやがる
entries.en: ...Hmph.\nTalking like\nyou know it all.

entries.jp: それに　わしの\n能天気も天気のうちだ\nなあ？　シンディ
entries.en:
Besides, the
sunshine
between my ears
is weather too!
Right, Shindy?

entries.jp: そう思うのはお前だけだ
entries.en: That's just you

entries.jp: まあ　そうかもな
entries.en: Well, maybe so

entries.jp: 御託はいい
entries.en: Spare me\nthe speech

entries.jp: そう思うのは\nお前だけだ
entries.en: That's just you.

entries.jp: そうか？\nシンディは\nつれないぜよ～
entries.en: That so? Shindy,\nyou're so cold~

entries.jp: でも　そこが龍馬くんの\n良いところなんですよね
entries.en: But that's one of\nRyoma-kun's good\npoints, isn't it?

entries.jp: まあ\nそうかもな
entries.en: Well, maybe so.

entries.jp: 天気も気持ちも\nうじうじしているよりは\nずっとマシだ
entries.en:
In weather or in
mood, it beats
moping around
by a mile.

entries.jp: おー　シンディも\n話がわかるように\nなったか！
entries.en: Hey, Shindy\nfinally gets it!

entries.jp: くっ　上から目線で\n言われると腹が立つな
entries.en:
Tch. It ticks
me off when
you talk down
to me like that.

entries.jp: まあまあ　晋作\n龍馬くんはそんな風に\n思ってはいないですよ
entries.en:
Now, now,
Shinsaku.
Ryoma-kun
doesn't mean
it that way.

entries.jp: だから\n腹が立つんだ！
entries.en: That's exactly\nwhy it ticks\nme off!

entries.jp: 御託はいい\n雷舞の事に集中しろ
entries.en: Spare me the\nspeech. Focus\non the live.

entries.jp: もちろん雷舞が第一じゃ\nカラッとした気持ちで\n挑むぜよ
entries.en:
Course the live
comes first! I'll
take it on with a
clear-sky heart!

entries.jp: 本当に\n能天気だな……
entries.en: You really do\nhave sunshine\nfor brains...

entries.jp: ふふふ\n龍馬くんらしいですね
entries.en: Hehehe. That's so\nlike Ryoma-kun.

entries.jp: いや　ちょっと待て\n能天気に雨も曇りもあるか
entries.en:
Wait, hold on.
Since when does
sunshine between
the ears get rain
or clouds?

entries.jp: お前の頭の中は\n年中晴天だろうが
entries.en:
It's clear skies
in that head
of yours all
year round!

entries.jp: おお　いいところに\n気が付いたな！
entries.en: Ooh, now you've\nhit on somethin'!

entries.jp: シンディの言うとおりぜよ\nわしの心は年がら年中\n晴天続きだからなっ！
entries.en:
Shindy's right! My
heart's got nothin'
but clear skies, all
year long!

entries.jp: 別に褒めてねえ
entries.en: That wasn't a\ncompliment.

entries.jp: だから龍馬くんの\nロックには　ブレが\nないんですね
entries.en: That's why\nRyoma-kun's rock\nnever wavers.

entries.jp: 物は言い様だな\nまあいい
entries.en: That's one way\nto put it. Fine,\nwhatever.

entries.jp: だがな\n舞い上がっていると\n足下をすくわれるぞ
entries.en:
But get carried
away, and
they'll knock
your feet out
from under you.

entries.jp: オレ様達の影響で\n長州や薩摩の志士が\n動き出したらしい
entries.en:
Apparently,
thanks to yours
truly and
company, the
rebels in Choshu
and Satsuma
have started
making moves.

entries.jp: うん　そうらしいですね\n天歌の影響が薄い所から\n動きが出て来たみたい
entries.en:
Yes, so it seems.
Things seem to be
stirring wherever
Heaven's Song's
influence is weak.

entries.jp: 幕府はオレ様たちを\nますます放って\nおいちゃくれないぜ
entries.en:
The shogunate's
going to be
even less
willing to leave
yours truly and
company alone.

entries.jp: ちったぁ気にしねえとな\nそうだろ　桂さん
entries.en:
We'd better keep
that in mind a
little. Right,
Katsura-san?

entries.jp: 忘れてはいないよ
entries.en: I haven't\nforgotten

entries.jp: 少し気を張りすぎじゃ？
entries.en: A bit too tense?

entries.jp: 任せてよ
entries.en: Leave it to me

entries.jp: 忘れてはいないよ\n十分に気を付けよう
entries.en: I haven't\nforgotten. Let's\nbe very careful.

entries.jp: 二人とも心配し過ぎだ\nのーぷろぶれむ！
entries.en: You two worry\ntoo much! No\nproblem-o!

entries.jp: 龍馬は\n考えなさすぎだ！
entries.en: Ryoma, you don't\nthink enough!

entries.jp: 晋作は\n少し気を張りすぎ\nじゃない？
entries.en: Shinsaku,\naren't you a\nbit too tense?

entries.jp: 桂さんまで\n呑気な事を……
entries.en:
Even you're
saying
carefree stuff,
Katsura-san...

entries.jp: センセーはわかっとるな\nりらっくすした方が\n良い結果になるぜよ
entries.en: Sensei gets it!\nRelaxin' gets ya\nbetter results!

entries.jp: お前は\nもう少し緊張しろ！
entries.en: And you need\nto be a little\nmore nervous!

entries.jp: 晋作\nそこは私に任せて
entries.en: Shinsaku, leave\nthat part to me.

entries.jp: 私も\n幕府を甘く見ては\nいないですから
entries.en: I don't take\nthe shogunate\nlightly either.

entries.jp: ちゃんと考えて\n色々用意していますよ
entries.en:
I've thought it
through and
prepared all
sorts of things.

entries.jp: 桂さんが\nそこまで言うなら\nオレ様は何も言わん
entries.en:
If you go that
far, Katsura-san,
yours truly won't
say a word.

entries.jp: ワハハハ\nセンセーに任せておけば\n何の心配もいらんな
entries.en:
Wahahaha! Leave
it to Sensei, and
there's nothin' to
worry about!

entries.jp: 桂さんに任せてないで\nお前も少しは心配しろ！
entries.en:
Don't just leave
it to Katsura-san!
You worry a
little too!

entries.jp: でも本当に……
entries.en: But really...

entries.jp: 龍馬くんは何の心配もせず\nこのまま進んで\n行って欲しいですね
entries.en:
I'd like
Ryoma-kun to
keep moving
forward just like
this, without a
single worry.

entries.jp: 心配事は\n私や晋作が受け持てば\nいいだけのことですし
entries.en: Shinsaku and I\ncan simply take\non the worrying.

entries.jp: バカの考え休むに似たり\nとも言うしな
entries.en:
Like they say,
a fool thinking
is as good as a
fool napping.

entries.jp: それに\n龍馬の欠点を挙げたら\nそれこそキリがねえ
entries.en:
Besides, if we
started listing
Ryoma's flaws,
there'd be no
end to it.

entries.jp: もう　歌って　歌って\n歌い通すしかないんだ\nロックバカだからなっ！
entries.en:
All he can do is
sing and sing
and sing it
through! He's a
rock-crazy idiot!

entries.jp: その通りじゃ！\nさあ　今日も\n思いっきり歌うぜよ！
entries.en:
Darn right!
Now, let's sing
our hearts out
again today!

entries.jp: わしのロックで\n怒濤の豪雨を降らせて\n天歌泰平を押し流す！
entries.en:
With my rock, I'll
bring down a
raging downpour
and wash the
Heaven's Song
Peace away!

entries.jp: 晴天なのか豪雨なのか\nハッキリしろ！\nこの能天気野郎が！
entries.en:
Clear skies or
a downpour,
make up your
mind! You
sunshine-brained
idiot!

entries.jp: わははは\n細かいことはええんじゃ\nちゃっちゃと行こう！
entries.en:
Wahahaha!
Never mind the
details! Let's
get a move on!

entries.jp: ちっ\nおい待て龍馬！
entries.en: Tch. Hey,\nwait, Ryoma!

entries.jp: ったく\nオレ様達がいなきゃ\n何もできねえクセに
entries.en:
Honestly. As if
he could do a
thing without
yours truly
and company.

entries.jp: おい龍馬！\nオレ様より前を\n歩くんじゃねえ！
entries.en:
Hey, Ryoma!
Don't you dare
walk ahead of
yours truly!

entries.jp: 坂本龍馬達の影響を\n受けて各地の志士が\n立ち上がったそうだね
entries.en:
I hear rebels all
over have risen
up, inspired by
Ryoma Sakamoto
and his band.

entries.jp: 予の天歌泰平は\n正しいのかな……
entries.en: Is my Heaven's\nSong Peace...\ntruly right?

entries.jp: 慶喜様\n心を揺らしてはなりませぬ\nそれが彼奴らめの狙い
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama,
you must not
let your heart
waver. That is
precisely what
those wretches
are after.

entries.jp: 自由などと言う甘言を\n振り回して　人心に\nつけ込んでいるのです
entries.en:
They brandish
sweet words
like "freedom"
to prey upon
people's hearts.

entries.jp: 自由には責任が伴うもの\nしかし万人が果たせるわけ\nではありませぬ
entries.en:
Freedom carries
responsibility.
But not everyone
is able to bear it.

entries.jp: 民衆を束ね\n苦痛を取り払い\n泰平を与える
entries.en:
To unite the
people, take
away their
pain, and grant
them peace...

entries.jp: そして　その責は\n代々徳川家の将軍が\n担ってきたのです
entries.en:
That duty has
been borne by the
shoguns of the
Tokugawa house
for generations.

entries.jp: それが\n予の務めだったね
entries.en: That was my\nduty, wasn't it.

entries.jp: そうです　慶喜様\nあなたにしかできぬこと
entries.en:
Indeed,
Yoshinobu-sama.
It is something
only you can do.

entries.jp: 慶喜様の天歌泰平は\n唯一無二　恐れることは\nなにもございません
entries.en:
Your Heaven's
Song Peace is
one of a kind,
Yoshinobu-sama.
There is nothing
whatsoever to
fear.

entries.jp: そうか\n直弼がそう言うのであれば
entries.en: I see. If Naosuke\nsays so...

entries.jp: しかし超魂の力を思うと\n予は気が気ではないんだ
entries.en:
But when I think
of the Ultra
Soul's power, I
can't rest easy.

entries.jp: 超魂は復活あたわず\nあれはホンの欠片\n大した力はありませぬ
entries.en:
The Ultra Soul
cannot be revived.
What they have is
a mere fragment,
with no great
power.

entries.jp: 欠片でもあの男の歌に\n心震わされ目覚める志士が\n現れるかもしれない
entries.en:
Even a
fragment... Rebels
whose hearts are
stirred by that
man's songs may
awaken.

entries.jp: それが予は恐ろしい\n予は坂本の力が恐ろしい
entries.en: That frightens\nme. I fear\nSakamoto's power.

entries.jp: ではこうしましょう\n慶喜様
entries.en: Then let\nus do this,\nYoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: 坂本達をこちらに取り込み\n慶喜様の良いように\n使えるようにしましょう
entries.en:
Let us bring
Sakamoto and his
band over to our
side, so that you
may use them as
you see fit,
Yoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: なに　そんなことが\n容易く出来るのか？
entries.en: What? Can\nsuch a thing be\ndone so easily?

entries.jp: はい\nすでに策は\n練っております
entries.en: Yes. I have\nalready\ndevised a plan.

entries.jp: そうか　そうか\nこれで予はやっと\n安心出来る！
entries.en: I see, I see!\nNow at last I\ncan be at ease!

entries.jp: 坂本が予の味方になる！\nなんて素晴らしいんだ
entries.en: Sakamoto will\nbe on my side!\nHow wonderful!

entries.jp:
喜色満面の慶喜は
直弼に抱きつく
直弼はそれを
優しく受け止め
慶喜の背中を撫でる
entries.en:
Beaming with
joy, Yoshinobu
threw his arms
around Naosuke.
Naosuke gently
caught him and
stroked his back.

entries.jp: 慶喜様\nどうかご安心を
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama,\nplease, rest easy.

entries.jp: うん　うん\n直弼の手は暖かだな
entries.en: Mm-hm, mm-hm.\nYour hands are so\nwarm, Naosuke.

entries.jp: 優しく慰める直弼に\n慶喜は眼を細めて頷いた
entries.en:
As Naosuke
gently soothed
him, Yoshinobu
narrowed his
eyes and nodded.

entries.jp:
一方そのころ
街道雷舞から戻った
龍馬達はテラーダに
集まっていた
entries.en:
Meanwhile,
back from
their roadside
live, Ryoma
and the others
had gathered
at the Terada.

entries.jp: おわっと
entries.en: Whoa there!

entries.jp: ああ　これは見事に\nお皿を割って\nしまいましたねえ
entries.en: Oh dear, you've\nbroken that plate\nquite thoroughly.

entries.jp: 注意力が散漫なんだ\nおい　欠片に気をつけろよ
entries.en:
You're too
careless. Hey,
watch out for
the shards.

entries.jp: 指はギタリストの\n命だからな\n怪我をされちゃかなわねえ
entries.en:
A guitarist's
fingers are his
life. I can't have
you getting hurt.

entries.jp: むうう　なんだか急に\n背筋がゾクッとした
entries.en:
Hrmm... All of
a sudden, a
chill ran right
down my spine.

entries.jp: どうしたんです\n龍馬くん\n風邪でも引いた？
entries.en: What's wrong,\nRyoma-kun? Did\nyou catch a cold?

entries.jp: それはない！\nバカは風邪を引かない
entries.en: No way! Idiots\ndon't catch colds.

entries.jp: でも夏風邪を引くのは\nバカとも言われてますよ
entries.en: But they also say\nonly idiots catch\nsummer colds.

entries.jp: そういや　わしは　\nちょいちょい\n夏場に風邪引くぜよ
entries.en:
Come to think
of it, I catch
colds in summer
every so often!

entries.jp: あははは\n龍馬くんったら\n自己申告しなくても
entries.en:
Ahahaha! Oh,
Ryoma-kun,
you didn't have
to confess.

entries.jp: わかった！\n風邪を引こうが\n引くまいがお前はバカだ
entries.en: That settles it!\nCold or no cold,\nyou're an idiot.

entries.jp: むう　バカは承知じゃ\nしかし尻までモゾモゾ\nするのはなんじゃ？
entries.en:
Hrm, I know I'm
an idiot. But
why's my backside
all itchy too?

entries.jp: なんだ　本当に風邪か？\n玉子酒でもかっくらって\n体を温めて寝ちまえ
entries.en:
What, you really
caught a cold?
Knock back some
egg sake, warm
up, and go to bed.

entries.jp: ……玉子酒ですか\n私が改良した玉子酒を\n試してみます？
entries.en:
...Egg sake, you
say? Would
you like to try
the egg sake
I've improved?

entries.jp: センセーの玉子酒？
entries.en: Sensei's egg sake?

entries.jp: 普通の玉子酒よりも\nよく効くと思いますよ～\nふふふ……実験台
entries.en:
I believe it works
better than
ordinary egg
sake~ Hehehe... a
test subject.

entries.jp: ちょっ！\nそれはやめとけ\n普通でいいんだ普通で
entries.en: Wait! Don't you\ndare. Normal's\nfine. Normal!

entries.jp: お登勢さんに普通の\n玉子酒を用意してもらえ
entries.en: Have Otose-san\nmake you some\nnormal egg sake.

entries.jp: え～\n晋作はつれない\nですねぇ
entries.en: Aww. You're no\nfun, Shinsaku.

entries.jp: 桂さんの玉子酒は何が\n入れられるかわからん\n恐ろしい飲み物だからな
entries.en:
Katsura-san's
egg sake is a
terrifying
drink. Nobody
knows what
he'll put in it.

entries.jp: あれ？\nそういやお登勢やんの\n姿が見えんが？
entries.en:
Huh? Come
to think of
it, where's
Otose-yan?

entries.jp: おかしいですね……\nちょっと買い物に行くと\n言って出たけれど
entries.en:
That's odd... She
said she was
going out to do a
little shopping...

entries.jp: 言われてみれば\n帰りが遅いですね……
entries.en: Now that you\nmention it, she's\nlate getting back...

entries.jp: 迎えに行こう
entries.en: Let's go get her

entries.jp: 心配いらんぜよ
entries.en: No need to worry

entries.jp: ちぃと気になるが
entries.en: Kinda bothers me

entries.jp: それなら皆でお登勢やんを\n迎えに行こう\nわしは心配じゃ
entries.en:
Then let's all go
fetch Otose-yan!
I'm worried
about her.

entries.jp: いや　そこまでは\n少し遅いので\n気になっただけですから
entries.en:
Oh, it's not that
serious. I was
only a little
concerned
because she's a
bit late.

entries.jp: そう言われても心配じゃ\nみんなで迎えに行くぜよ
entries.en: Even so, I'm\nworried! We're all\ngoin' to get her!

entries.jp: 買い物が長引いてるんだろ\nじきに帰って来るさ\nおまえは妙に心配性だな
entries.en:
Her shopping's
just taking a
while. She'll be
back soon enough.
You're weirdly
quick to worry.

entries.jp: むう　みながそういうなら\n待つ方がいいか
entries.en:
Hrm. If everybody
says so, I guess
waitin's the better
bet.

entries.jp: 心配いらんぜよ\nまだそんな遅いわけでも\nないから
entries.en: No need to worry!\nIt ain't even that\nlate yet.

entries.jp: どこかで着物でも眺めて\n道草食ってるんじゃろう
entries.en:
I bet she's
dawdlin'
somewhere,
eyein' kimonos
or somethin'.

entries.jp: ありがちな話だ
entries.en: Sounds\nabout right.

entries.jp: だといいんだけど\nそれにしてはちょっと\n遅くないですかね？
entries.en: I hope so, but\nisn't she a bit late\neven for that?

entries.jp: ちぃと気になるが\n道草食ってるにしては\n戻るのが遅いなぁ
entries.en:
Kinda bothers
me, though. She's
takin' a long time
to get back, even
for dawdlin'.

entries.jp: 確かに妙だな
entries.en: It is strange.

entries.jp: どうも\n胸騒ぎがする
entries.en: I've got a bad\nfeeling about this.

entries.jp: 勘というやつですか？\n何事もなければ\n良いのですが
entries.en:
A hunch, you
mean? I hope
nothing has
happened.

entries.jp: ……おや？

何か異変を
感じたのか
桂が窓の外へ
目をやった
entries.en:
As if sensing
something
amiss, Katsura
turned his eyes
to the window.

entries.jp: ……おい　桂さん
entries.en: ...Hey,\nKatsura-san.

entries.jp: ……晋作も\n気付きましたか？
entries.en: ...You noticed\ntoo, Shinsaku?

entries.jp: ああ\n表通りから　人の\n気配が消えた
entries.en:
Yeah. All sign
of people has
vanished from
the main street.

entries.jp: どうしたんじゃ\nセンセー　シンディ\n急に立ち上がって？
entries.en:
What's goin'
on, Sensei,
Shindy? Why'd
ya stand up all
of a sudden?

entries.jp: 龍馬はそこを動くな\n……馬が駆けてくる
entries.en:
Ryoma, don't
move from
there. ...A horse
is galloping
this way.

entries.jp: なんじゃなんじゃ？\n暴れ馬か？
entries.en: What's this,\nwhat's this? A\nrunaway horse?

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\n危ないっ！
entries.en: Ryoma-kun,\nlook out!

entries.jp: うごぁっ
entries.en: Oogh!

entries.jp:
桂が龍馬を
突き飛ばすのと同時に
それまで龍馬が立って
いた場所に　白羽の
矢が突き立っていた
entries.en:
The instant
Katsura shoved
Ryoma aside, a
white-fletched
arrow struck
right where
Ryoma had
been standing.

entries.jp: 馬で通りすがりに\n矢を射ってきた？
entries.en: Someone shot an\narrow at us while\nriding past?

entries.jp: ほほう\nこれが京の流鏑馬か
entries.en:
Oho! So this
is Kyoto-style
horseback
archery!

entries.jp: いや～風流　風流
entries.en: My, how elegant,\nhow elegant!

entries.jp: バカ野郎！\nこれに当たったら\n風流じゃすまねえぞ！
entries.en:
You idiot! If that
had hit you,
"elegant" wouldn't
begin to cover it!

entries.jp: 高杉は\n壁に突き立った矢を\n引き抜いた
entries.en: Takasugi pulled\nout the arrow\nstuck in the wall.

entries.jp: それは……\n矢文のようですね
entries.en: That's... a letter\ntied to an\narrow, it seems.

entries.jp: 何が書いてあるんじゃ？
entries.en: What's it say?

entries.jp: ちょっと待て\n急かすな\n開けてみる
entries.en: Hold on. Don't\nrush me. I'll\nopen it.

entries.jp: 高杉は矢から\n文を引き抜いて\n開く
entries.en:
Takasugi pulled
the letter from
the arrow and
opened it.

entries.jp: なになに……
entries.en: Let's see...

entries.jp: 幕府からの御前試合\n（ロイヤルコンサート）への\n招待状と書いてある
entries.en:
It says it's an
invitation from
the shogunate to
a Royal Concert.

entries.jp: 幕府から？
entries.en: From the\nshogunate?

entries.jp: そうか　そうか\nそりゃええ！
entries.en: Well, well! Now\nain't that great!

entries.jp: 幕府がわしらを招いて\nくれるということか！
entries.en: So the\nshogunate's\ninvitin' us over!

entries.jp: おいおい\nそんな気楽な話じゃ\nねえだろ
entries.en: Whoa, whoa. It's\nnot that simple.

entries.jp: 招待状をくれたんだぞ
entries.en: But they sent\nus an invitation!

entries.jp: そりゃわしらのことを\n幕府が認めたってこと\nじゃろ
entries.en:
That means the
shogunate's
recognized us,
don't it?

entries.jp: よく考えろこのバカが！\n矢文を射ち込まれてんだ
entries.en:
Think it through,
you idiot! They
shot a letter at
us on an arrow!

entries.jp: どう考えたって\n好意的じゃねえだろが！
entries.en: Any way you\nslice it, that's\nnot friendly!

entries.jp: ちいとばかり\n内気なのかもしれんな
entries.en: Maybe they're just\na teensy bit shy.

entries.jp: バカ野郎！\n内気なヤツが白昼堂々\n矢を射ち込むか
entries.en:
You idiot! Since
when does a shy
guy fire arrows
at people in
broad daylight!?

entries.jp: その脳味噌叩き起こして\nじっくり考えろっ！
entries.en: Smack that brain\nof yours awake\nand think it over!

entries.jp: あいたー！
entries.en: Owww!

entries.jp: みんな\n無事かい？
entries.en: Everyone, are\nyou all right?

entries.jp: 新選組の連中が\n表通りを封鎖していて\n何事かと思ったよ
entries.en:
The Shinsengumi
had the main
street blocked
off. I wondered
what in the world
was going on.

entries.jp: 新選組ですか……
entries.en: The Shinsengumi,\nyou say...

entries.jp: そうなのよぅ\nそれで戻ってくるのが\n遅くなったってワケ
entries.en:
That's right,
dear. That's why
I was so late
getting back.

entries.jp: そうでしたか……
entries.en: I see...

entries.jp: なんにしろ\nみんなが無事で\n安心したわぁ
entries.en: Anyway, what a\nrelief that you\nboys are all safe.

entries.jp: あからさまな\n罠に見えるけど\n晋作はどう思います？
entries.en:
It looks like an
obvious trap to
me. What do you
think, Shinsaku?

entries.jp: 完全に罠だな　桂さん\nだとしてもこれは挑戦状だ\n逃げるわけにはいかねぇ
entries.en:
It's a trap, all
right,
Katsura-san.
Even so, this is a
challenge. We
can't run from it.

entries.jp: 罠だろうがなんだろうが\n敵からしっぽを巻くなんて\nオレ様の辞書にはねぇよ
entries.en:
Trap or not,
turning tail on
the enemy isn't
in yours truly's
vocabulary.

entries.jp: え？\nこれ罠なのか？
entries.en: Huh? This\nis a trap?

entries.jp: 素でキョトンとするな！\n罠に決まってるだろうがっ
entries.en:
Don't look at me
all blank like you
mean it! Of
course it's a trap!

entries.jp: 罠だよ　龍馬くん\nだから行くのは\n止めましょう
entries.en: It's a trap,\nRyoma-kun.\nSo let's not go.

entries.jp: ううう\nそうは言うても\nせっかくの機会じゃし
entries.en:
Ugh... Even so,
it's a chance
we might not
get again...

entries.jp: そうだ　今回ばかりは\n龍馬の言う通りだぜ
entries.en: That's right. For\nonce, Ryoma's\ngot a point.

entries.jp: 虎穴に入らずんば\n虎児を得ずってな
entries.en:
Like they say, if
you don't enter
the tiger's den,
you can't catch
its cub.

entries.jp: 確かに罠だが\nむしろ好機だと\n思えばいい
entries.en:
Sure, it's a
trap, but we
should see it as
an opportunity
instead.

entries.jp: じゃあ晋作が前を\n歩いて先に落とし穴に\n落ちてください
entries.en:
Then, Shinsaku,
please walk in
front and fall into
the pit trap first.

entries.jp: お　おい桂さん\nなんでオレ様が\n落ちなきゃならねぇんだ
entries.en:
H-hey,
Katsura-san! Why
does yours truly
have to fall in?

entries.jp: わしは歌えるのなら\n何でもいいぜよ！
entries.en: As long as I get\nto sing, I'm good\nwith anything!

entries.jp: どんな場所だろうと\nわしは思いっきり\nロックするだけじゃ！
entries.en:
Wherever it is,
I'm just gonna
rock out with
all I've got!

entries.jp: ふぅ……止めても\nそうなるだろうって\n予想はしていましたが
entries.en:
Phew... I had a
feeling it would
come to this
even if I tried
to stop you...

entries.jp: こうなったら\n私も腹をくくりましょう
entries.en: In that case, I'll\nsteel myself too.

entries.jp: おう\nそうこないとな！
entries.en: Yeah! That's\nmore like it!

entries.jp: そうじゃ\nそうじゃ！
entries.en: That's right,\nthat's right!

entries.jp: 幕府がわざわざ招待して\nくれたんじゃ！
entries.en: The shogunate\nwent outta its\nway to invite us!

entries.jp: 御前試合に乗り込んで\nわしらの歌で\n天歌泰平をうち破るぜよ！
entries.en:
We'll charge into
the Royal Concert
and smash the
Heaven's Song
Peace with our
songs!

entries.jp: あはは\nすっかりやる気を\n出してますね
entries.en: Ahaha. You're\nall fired up now.

entries.jp: せっかくのご招待\n正面から乗り込んで\nやろうじゃねぇか
entries.en:
They went to
the trouble of
inviting us. Let's
march right in
through the
front door.

entries.jp: うん　私もそう思い\n始めたところですよ
entries.en: Yes, I was just\nstarting to\nthink the same.

entries.jp: でも　罠だという事には\n変わりないですよ？
entries.en: But it's still a\ntrap, you know?

entries.jp: 二人とも　くれぐれも\n気をつけて下さいね
entries.en: Both of you,\nplease, be\nvery careful.

entries.jp: わかってるって！\nノリノリで行くぜよ！
entries.en: I know, I know!\nWe're goin' in\npumped!

entries.jp: シンディも同じように\nノリノリじゃ！
entries.en: And Shindy's just\nas pumped as me!

entries.jp: お前の能天気と\n一緒にするんじゃねえ！
entries.en:
Don't lump
me in with
your sunshine
for brains!

entries.jp: つれん事を言うなって\nさっそくみんなで\n練習するぜよ
entries.en:
Aw, don't be so
cold! Let's all
get practicin'
right away!

entries.jp: なんてったって\n御前試合じゃ！
entries.en: It's a Royal\nConcert, after all!

entries.jp: とにかく\n期日までやれることを\nやろうぜ
entries.en:
Anyway, let's
do what we
can before the
day comes.

entries.jp: 私も先に打てる手を\n考えておきましょう
entries.en:
I'll think up
some moves we
can make in
advance, too.

entries.jp: センセー　シンディ\n今すぐ練習しよう！
entries.en: Sensei, Shindy,\nlet's practice\nright now!

entries.jp: 御前試合の日まで\n三日しかないし\n気合いを入れるぜよ！
entries.en:
There's only three
days till the Royal
Concert! Time to
get fired up!

entries.jp: シンディ\nその矢を貸してくれ
entries.en: Shindy, lend\nme that arrow!

entries.jp: 振り回すな\nバカ野郎っ
entries.en: Don't swing it\naround, you idiot!

entries.jp: ふふふ　引き抜いた矢を\nマイク代わりにして\n歌うとはね
entries.en:
Hehehe. Using
the arrow he
pulled out as
a microphone
to sing...

entries.jp: 龍馬くんは\n大物の器ですね
entries.en: Ryoma-kun truly\nhas the makings\nof a big shot.

entries.jp:
そうして
練習を重ね――
御前試合へと
備えた
entries.en:
And so, practicing
again and again,
they prepared for
the Royal Concert.

entries.jp: トシ\n少しいいか？
entries.en: Toshi, got\na minute?

entries.jp: どうしたんですか\n神妙な顔で
entries.en: What is it? You\nlook so serious.

entries.jp: 最近\n総司の様子は\nどうだ？
entries.en: How's Soji\nbeen lately?

entries.jp: 総司ですか？\nどう　と言われても
entries.en: Soji? Even if you\nask me how...

entries.jp: 様子がおかしいとか\nそういうことはないか？
entries.en:
Has he been
acting strange,
anything like
that?

entries.jp: 元々掴みどころが\nないヤツですから
entries.en: He's always been\nhard to read.

entries.jp: ううむ……
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.jp: 近藤さんらしくもない
entries.en: That's not like\nyou, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 何か気になることが\nあるなら　本人に\n聞けばいいでしょう
entries.en:
If something's
bothering
you, just ask
him yourself.

entries.jp: それもそうだな\n総司はどこへ行った？
entries.en: Fair enough.\nWhere did\nSoji go?

entries.jp: 総司なら\n井伊大老に呼ばれて\n登城してますが
entries.en:
Soji? He was
summoned to
the castle by
Great Elder Ii.

entries.jp: トシ\n二条城へ行くぞ\nついてこい
entries.en:
Toshi, we're
going to Nijo
Castle. Come
with me.

entries.jp: えっ？\n二条城へ？\nどうして……
entries.en: What? To Nijo\nCastle? Why...

entries.jp: 待ってください\n近藤さん\n
entries.en: Wait, Kondo-san!

entries.jp: オン\nキリキリバサラ\nウンハッタ……
entries.en: On kiri kiri\nbasara un hatta

entries.jp:
我が呪いの力が
片魂（ピースソウル）に
深く深く
食い込んでいる……
entries.en:
The power of my
curse has bitten
deep, deep into
the Piece Soul...

entries.jp: さぞ楽しい夢を\n見ているのであろうな
entries.en: You must be\nhaving such\npleasant dreams.

entries.jp: その夢が　お前の力を\n引き出すのだ……
entries.en: Those dreams\nwill draw out\nyour power...

entries.jp: フンッ
entries.en: Hmph.

entries.jp: 魂が喰らい尽くされるまで\n今少し　時間が欲しい\nところだが
entries.en:
I would like a
little more time
before his soul
is devoured
completely, but...

entries.jp: まあ良い
entries.en: No matter.

entries.jp: それまで　存分に\n天歌を広めて\nもらおうか
entries.en:
Until then, I
shall have him
spread Heaven's
Song to his
heart's content.

entries.jp: ……なんだ？
entries.en: ...What is it?

entries.jp: 困ります！\n井伊様に　誰も通すなと\n命じられているのです！
entries.en:
You can't!
Ii-sama ordered
that no one be
allowed through!

entries.jp: 危急の用だ\n責任は俺が取る
entries.en: It's an emergency.\nI'll take\nresponsibility.

entries.jp: 総司！\nどこだ？\n総司
entries.en: Soji! Where\nare you? Soji!

entries.jp: 騒がしい\n何事だ？
entries.en: What is\nthis racket?

entries.jp: 失礼つかまつる\n新選組　局長\n近藤勇であります
entries.en:
Pardon the
intrusion. I am
Isami Kondo,
Commander of
the Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: 同じく新選組副長\n土方歳三
entries.en:
Likewise,
Shinsengumi
Vice-Commander,
Toshizo Hijikata.

entries.jp: 申し訳ありません！\nこの者達が　どうしても\n井伊様に目通りしたいと
entries.en:
I'm terribly
sorry! These
men insisted on
an audience with
you, Ii-sama!

entries.jp: そうか　良い\n呼ぶまで下がっておれ
entries.en: I see. Very well.\nWithdraw until\nI call for you.

entries.jp: はっ！
entries.en: Yes, sir!

entries.jp: で？\n何の用か
entries.en: Well? What is\nyour business?

entries.jp: 部下の沖田総司を\n迎えに来ました！
entries.en:
We've come
to take my
subordinate,
Soji Okita,
back with us!

entries.jp: 沖田なら　確かに\nここにいるが――
entries.en: Okita is indeed\nhere, but--

entries.jp: ……ううぅ
entries.en: ...Uuugh...

entries.jp: 総司\n近藤さん\n総司の様子が変だ
entries.en: Soji! Kondo-san,\nsomething's\nwrong with Soji!

entries.jp: ……井伊大老\n総司に何をした？
entries.en: ...Great Elder\nIi, what did\nyou do to Soji?

entries.jp: 事と場合によっては――
entries.en: Depending on\nyour answer--

entries.jp: 剣呑だな\n土方
entries.en: How menacing,\nHijikata.

entries.jp: 我が沖田に\nなにをしたと？\n証拠でもあるのか？
entries.en:
What have I
done to Okita,
you ask? Have
you any proof?

entries.jp: 証拠？\nそれは――
entries.en: Proof? That's...

entries.jp: 証拠など必要ない\n他の誰も気付かなくても\n俺にはわかる……
entries.en:
We need no
proof. Even if no
one else notices,
I can tell...

entries.jp: 我は　沖田に\n歌の手ほどきを\nしたまでだ
entries.en:
I have merely
given Okita
some instruction
in song.

entries.jp: 疑うのなら\n本人に聞いてみれば\n良いだろう
entries.en: If you doubt\nme, why not ask\nhim yourselves?

entries.jp: そうですよぉ\n近藤さんも　土方さんも\nどうしたんですか
entries.en:
That's right~
Kondo-san,
Hijikata-san,
what's the matter
with you two?

entries.jp: 井伊様の\n手ほどきを受けると\n歌がね　うまくなるんです
entries.en:
When Ii-sama
gives me lessons,
my singing, you
know, it gets
better.

entries.jp: どんどん　どんどん\nうまくなっていくのが\nわかるんです……
entries.en:
I can feel it
getting better
and better
and better...

entries.jp: 今の僕の歌を聴いたら\n近藤さんも抗えないんじゃ\nないかな？　うふふ……
entries.en:
If you heard me
sing now,
Kondo-san, I
don't think even
you could
resist. Tee hee...

entries.jp: 総司……\n冗談でも言っていい事と\n悪い事があるぞ
entries.en:
Soji... Even as
a joke, there
are things
you don't say.

entries.jp: 冗談？\n冗談のつもりはないよ\n土方さん……
entries.en: A joke? I'm\nnot joking,\nHijikata-san...

entries.jp: 総司
entries.en: Soji...

entries.jp: フフフフフ\n面白そうだ
entries.en: Hehehehe...\nHow amusing.

entries.jp: 新選組の局長と副長をも\n泰平化できるとなれば
entries.en:
If I can pacify
even the
Commander and
Vice-Commander
of the
Shinsengumi...

entries.jp: 我が呪いの力も\nいよいよ完成に\n近づいたと言うことだ……
entries.en:
...then the power
of my curse is
finally nearing
completion...

entries.jp: 呪いだと\nやはり総司に\n何かしたのだな
entries.en: A curse!? So you\ndid do something\nto Soji!

entries.jp: このところの\n総司の歌は\nおかしかった
entries.en: Soji's singing has\nbeen off lately.

entries.jp: 総司の歌は　天賦の才だ\n民衆が酔いしれ　天歌に\n傾倒するのも当然……
entries.en:
Soji's singing is a
gift from heaven.
It's only natural
the people are
enraptured and
devoted to
Heaven's Song...

entries.jp: だが　しかし！
entries.en: But even so!

entries.jp: 今の総司の歌は\n俺が教えた歌じゃない！\nどこかが違う
entries.en:
The way Soji
sings now isn't
the singing I
taught him!
Something's
different!

entries.jp: あ　う……\n近藤さん……\nぼくは
entries.en: Ah... uh...\nKondo-san... I...

entries.jp: そう責めてやるな
entries.en: Don't be so\nhard on him.

entries.jp: なんだと？\n井伊大老　この期に及んで\nまだシラを切るつもりか！
entries.en:
What!? Great
Elder Ii, you
still mean to
play dumb, at
this point!?

entries.jp: 沖田が　我が呪いを\n受け入れたのも\n新選組の――
entries.en:
Okita accepted
my curse for
the sake of the
Shinsengumi--

entries.jp: いや近藤勇\nお前の掲げた理想とやらを\n実現するためではないか
entries.en:
No, Isami Kondo,
wasn't it to make
these so-called
ideals you hold
up come true?

entries.jp: 沖田を褒めこそすれ\n責める謂れはない\n違うか？
entries.en:
If anything, Okita
deserves praise.
There is no
reason to blame
him. Am I wrong?

entries.jp: なっ……
entries.en: Wha...

entries.jp: 俺が掲げた理想は\nそんなものではない！
entries.en: The ideals I hold\nup are nothing\nlike that!

entries.jp: 俺が目指したのは\n人が　自分の弱さのせいで\n誰かを傷つけなくていい
entries.en:
What I aimed for
is a world where
no one has to
hurt anyone
because of their
own weakness...

entries.jp: 争いを恐れずに\n誰もが穏やかに\n暮らせる世の中だ！
entries.en:
...a world where
no one has to
fear conflict,
and everyone
can live in peace!

entries.jp: 井伊大老に　今一度問う\nそのための　天歌泰平\nではなかったのか
entries.en:
Great Elder Ii,
I ask you once
more. Wasn't
that what the
Heaven's Song
Peace was for?

entries.jp: ……くっ\nフハハハハハハ
entries.en: ...Heh.\nFuhahahahaha!

entries.jp: 何がおかしい！
entries.en: What's so funny!?

entries.jp: 争いのない世界？\n穏やかに暮らせる\n世の中？
entries.en:
A world without
conflict? A world
where everyone
can live in peace?

entries.jp: そんなお為ごかしを\n心から信じていたのか？
entries.en:
You truly
believed such
empty
platitudes with
all your heart?

entries.jp: ハハハハハハハ！\nどこまでもおめでたい男だ
entries.en:
Hahahahahaha!
What an
utterly naive
man you are.

entries.jp: 俺は――俺達　新選組は\nその志に命を懸けてきた\nそれのどこがおめでたい
entries.en:
I... we, the
Shinsengumi,
have staked our
lives on that
cause. What about
that is naive?

entries.jp: そんなものはな\n最初から求めて\nおらぬのだよ
entries.en:
I never sought
any such thing,
not from the
very start.

entries.jp: なんだと……？\nでは　何のために\nこんなことを
entries.en: What...?\nThen what is\nall this for?

entries.jp: 決まっているだろう\n慶喜様のためだ
entries.en:
Isn't it
obvious? For
Yoshinobu-sama's
sake.

entries.jp: 慶喜様が　何者にも\n脅かされず生きていける\n世界こそ　正しい世界
entries.en:
A world where
Yoshinobu-sama
can live without
being threatened
by anyone. That
alone is the right
world.

entries.jp: 徳川の絶対統治！\n永遠に続く幕府
entries.en:
Absolute
Tokugawa rule!
A shogunate that
lasts forever!

entries.jp: そのために　天歌泰平を\n利用したまでのこと
entries.en: I merely used the\nHeaven's Song\nPeace to that end.

entries.jp: 慶喜様のためなら\n誰が何人死のうと\n知ったことではない
entries.en:
For
Yoshinobu-sama's
sake, I care
not who dies,
nor how many.

entries.jp: 慶喜様のために\n全ての魂を捧げるのだ！
entries.en: Offer up\nevery soul for\nYoshinobu-sama!

entries.jp: 違う！　俺達は\nそんなことのために\n歌ってきたんじゃない！
entries.en: No! That's not\nwhat we've been\nsinging for!

entries.jp: そうだろう！\n総司！\n目を覚ませ
entries.en: Isn't that right,\nSoji!? Wake up!

entries.jp: 僕の歌　すごいんですよ\n近藤さんにも聴いて\nほしいな……
entries.en:
My singing's
amazing, you
know... I want
Kondo-san to
hear it too...

entries.jp: 近藤さん\n総司は完全に\n操られている
entries.en: Kondo-san. Soji is\ncompletely under\nsomeone's control.

entries.jp: 総司　お前のために\n斬ってでも止めるぞ\n文句は後で聞く
entries.en:
Soji. For your
own sake, I'll
stop you, even if
I have to cut you
down. You can
complain later.

entries.jp: 茶番だな
entries.en: What a farce.

entries.jp: ……なんだと？
entries.en: ...What did\nyou say?

entries.jp: くだらぬ師弟愛は\n見飽きたと言ったのだ\n下がるが良い
entries.en:
I said I've
grown tired
of your pitiful
master-and-pupil
devotion.
Stand aside.

entries.jp: 井伊　貴様！
entries.en: Ii, you bastard!

entries.jp: 我に叛くか……
entries.en: So you would\ndefy me...

entries.jp: 我に叛くは\n徳川に叛くこと
entries.en: To defy me\nis to defy the\nTokugawa.

entries.jp: 徳川に叛くは\n慶喜様に叛くことだ
entries.en:
To defy the
Tokugawa
is to defy
Yoshinobu-sama.

entries.jp: 慶喜様に叛く者を\n我は誰一人として許さん
entries.en:
And I will forgive
no one who defies
Yoshinobu-sama.
Not a single soul.

entries.jp: 何をする気だ……
entries.en: What are you\nplanning...

entries.jp: オン\nキリキリバサラ\nウンハッタ！
entries.en: On kiri kiri\nbasara un hatta!

entries.jp: なんだ\nこの黒い煙は
entries.en: What is this\nblack smoke?

entries.jp: こ　これはまさに\n闇そのもの……\nぐはっ！
entries.en: Th-this is\ndarkness\nitself... Gahh!

entries.jp: 気が遠くなる……\n立っていられない……\nなんだ　これは……
entries.en:
I'm... losing
consciousness...
I can't stand...
What is this...

entries.jp: 出来れば貴様らの愛する\n沖田の魂が呪いで\n朽ち逝く様を
entries.en:
Ideally, I would
have let you
watch the soul
of your beloved
Okita rot away
under my curse...

entries.jp: 見せてやりたかったが\n残念だ
entries.en: ...but alas,\nwhat a pity.

entries.jp: 井伊！
entries.en: Ii!

entries.jp: これまで慶喜様に忠義を\n尽くしてくれたこと
entries.en:
For all the loyalty
you have shown
Yoshinobu-sama
until now...

entries.jp: この井伊直弼\n感謝しているぞ
entries.en: ...I, Naosuke Ii,\nam truly grateful.

entries.jp: うう……
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.jp: トシ……！\n総司……！
entries.en: Toshi...! Soji...!

entries.jp: しつこい虫ケラだ
entries.en: Persistent vermin.

entries.jp: お前達二人\nあとで　ゆっくりと\n泰平化してやろう
entries.en:
As for you two...
I shall take my
time pacifying
you later.

entries.jp: 魂の一片までも\n捧げてもらうぞ！\nはーっはっはっは
entries.en:
You will offer up
every last shred
of your souls! Ha
ha ha ha!

entries.jp: 総司……
entries.en: Soji...
